name: push_in
description: A slow push on the talking-head clips in one call: each main-track clip's scale keyed 1.00 to 1.07 across it (every other one from 1.04, so a cut changes the framing), the face kept in place. A clip a person framed is left alone. A human edit since the read is refused.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {pushed (clips), kept? (clips a person framed, left alone)}. detail adds the pushed ids.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: items
params.description: Only these clips: a JSON list of item ids. Default: every video on the main track.

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much each clip grows across it (0.07 is 7%).

params.name: anchor
params.description: The share of the height that stays put (a face, 0.35).
